name: Leadwell
summary: An eight-page client CRM that follows every customer from first lead to won deal
about: A client CRM for an agency, service company or B2B sales team. Leads turn into deals, deals move across a drag-and-drop pipeline, and a lead journey flow shows how many people reach each stage. Contacts, companies, activities, reports and settings all work with sample data from a Lahore agency.
how: Open a page from the sidebar; on a phone use the menu button.
On Overview, switch 7D, 30D or 12M to morph the revenue chart and hover the lead journey bands.
On Leads, search, filter by status, sort a column or press Convert to turn a lead into a deal.
On Pipeline, drag a deal to the next stage; dropping it on Won books the revenue and throws confetti. With a keyboard, focus a card and press Shift with an arrow key, or use its grip button.
Click any deal to open its drawer, change the stage, log an activity, edit or delete it (with undo).
Tick off tasks on Activities, read charts on Reports and use Settings to change probabilities, the target, the theme or reset the demo data.
Press Ctrl+K to search pages, deals, contacts and companies.
